disposition.basis: Native public alias bypasses the read-through cache. Python owns legacy cache/receipt publication; compatibility and rollback callers remain. Common contract explicitly permits an evidenced retained_compatibility decision.
disposition.java_surface: Eight-field typed historical READ, complete versioned key, explicit bounded range/date queries and configured ReadGroup.
disposition.write_rejection: READ-only DatasetDefinition rejects WRITE and WAL_REPLACE. No Java publisher or source-ingest checkpoint is introduced.
disposition.raw_read_semantics: Historical raw values only. No automatic latest generation, coverage certification, cache-hit or current-source freshness claim.

contract.source_version: Complete lowercase SHA-256 of original VIEW_SELECTS SQL, source table id and relevant partition metadata; not a physical snapshot token.
contract.page_version: Cache object name/id/directoryName/table_txn/WAL sequencerTxn pinned before/after each read and in nextCursor; physical and WAL counters are independently bound.
contract.time_semantics: Calendar date in an exact UTC-midnight TIMESTAMP carrier; not an event-time conversion.
contract.nullability: Required date/four LONG counts/source_version; avg_pct_change and total_amount_yi preserve null.
contract.units: Average percentage points and already converted yi yuan; no repeated amount/100000 conversion.
contract.ddl: Existing formal schema checked with SELECT only. Missing original cache/coverage model tables created only in attested private instance; no formal DDL.

python_owner.original_record_digest: Seven business values serialize with original _record_digest; source_version is separately validated as the complete receipt/cache generation key.

formal_readonly.protocol_diagnostic: Independent HTTP and PG numeric values, original serialization and digests are identical; receipt mismatch is real, not a timestamp/dtype/transport representation artifact.

fault_checks.business_version: Key/repository/general query/ReadGroup/cursor reject malformed lowercase64SHA before DB; wrong data/date types, null required fields, overflow and nonfinite numbers fail.
fault_checks.physical_snapshot: Missing/unsettled/suspended table/WAL, table identity or directory rebuild, physical or independent WAL counter change, and query drift reject continuation; unrelated TABLE behavior retained.
fault_checks.live_cursor: Real original publisher phases changed cache txn/WAL 1 -> 2 -> 3; old phase-one token rejected under the same actual query.
fault_checks.read_group: Actual configured typed binding and strict request parser verified; cancellation returns no page; bad schema/unknown property/source version rejected before JDBC.
fault_checks.transport: Private ownership and model/batch allowlists, one explicit flush, no automatic retry, UNKNOWN ACK saved before transport and close(flush=false) tested.
fault_checks.preflight_failure: Original multiline SELECT recognition initially failed before any submission/DDL. Failure preserved; first-keyword SELECT guard corrected and original publisher rerun succeeded.
fault_checks.normal_empty: No invented zero cache row; only actual source days published. Nullable/invalid field behavior covered by implementation tests.

python_script_tests.scope: Pure mocked failure boundaries; no actual DB/CIM/HTTP

known_limitations: Two sampled formal historical receipts fail original content digest; their data and evidence remain unchanged. Isolated compatibility acceptance does not repair or certify formal generations.
No new Java cache producer/sync job is part of this retained_compatibility decision. Original Python publisher and its receipt lifecycle remain necessary for nonnative callers.
Source revisions and concurrent producer races were not exercised with real source changes; identity/physical cursor drift and malformed/revised generation keys are covered by tests.
Actual sample measures are non-null; null/invalid aggregate carriers are implementation fault tests.
